nodes.name: Gate config
nodes.notes: Self-contained on purpose. The gate does not read your workflow's existing credential node, because it cannot know what you called it. Fill in the two boxes, and set `job` to the key this workflow uses in settings.workflow_schedules: P0.2_market_discovery, P0.3_book_volume_snapshot, P0.4_trade_history or P0.5_refresh_rules_text.
